purpose: Determine whether the correct user-specified NVIDIA hosted Nemotron route is operationally usable enough to retain in G0; this small canary cannot select a generator or establish quality.

candidate.reasoning_mode: provider default (official hosted route defaults to thinking)

diagnostic_taxonomy.slow_service: successful request wall-clock latency above the frozen operational thresholds
diagnostic_taxonomy.reasoning_overhead: provider-reported reasoning tokens and successful-call latency; reported separately and never relabeled as a 429

early_stop_safeguards: Stop after two explicit HTTP 429 physical attempts.
Stop after two terminal trajectories caused by exhausted transient retries.
After at least three successful turns, stop if successful-request median latency exceeds 45 seconds.

operational_retention_gate.rule: All thresholds must pass. The thresholds are operational screening criteria, not a quality ranking. Failure removes Nemotron from the 24-card G0; it does not imply that the underlying model is generally weak.

post_gate_candidate_policy.pass: Retain Nemotron as a provisional third-family configuration for later quality comparison; no generator is selected by this canary.
post_gate_candidate_policy.fail: Do not spend further G0 calls on Nemotron. Continue G0 with Llama 3.1 8B and Qwen 3.7 Plus; Qwen thinking may remain a declared sensitivity configuration rather than the default deployment candidate.

claim_boundary: This is a two-card transport/latency/reliability check. It cannot establish emotional-support quality, PM value, clinical safety, model superiority, or formal ESC-Eval performance.
authorization: Zero-call materialization and local tests only. The ten hosted inference calls require approval of the rendered identity, even though the approved cost ceiling is zero dollars.
